parts.name: Root
parts.description: The switch control. It makes a span with role="switch", and it keeps a hidden checkbox input correct for the form.

props.name: id
props.description:
The id of the hidden input, thus a `label[for]` element can point at the switch. If you give
none, the component makes one.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the root element.

props.name: name
props.description: The name that the form submits while the switch is on.

props.name: value
props.description: The value that the form submits while the switch is on. It does not change the visual state.

props.name: form
props.description: The id of the form of the hidden input.

props.name: checked
props.description: The checked state. By default it goes in the two directions: use `bind:checked`.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: The checked state at the start, for when you give no `checked`.

props.name: controlledChecked
props.description:
Give your own code full control of the state. The component stops to write back to `checked`,
and it reports only through `onCheckedChange`. Thus the parent can refuse a change: the parent
does not send the new value down. The default is off, because `bind:checked` is the usual case
and it needs the write-back.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: The component calls it when the user changes the switch.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Stops the interaction with the switch and removes it from the focus order.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Keeps the switch focusable, but stops the changes of the state.

props.name: required
props.description: Makes the hidden input required for the form validation.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The accessible name, for when the user sees no name.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: The id of the element that gives the switch its name.

props.name: tabindex
props.description: Replaces the default position in the tab order.

dataAttributes.name: data-checked
dataAttributes.description: Present while the switch is on.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the switch is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the focus must be visible (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the switch has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-pressed
dataAttributes.description: Present while a pointer or the keyboard presses the switch.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the switch is readonly.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when the switch is required.

dataAttributes.name: data-unchecked
dataAttributes.description: Present while the switch is off.
